Meals & Entertainment.description: Covers individual business meals up to $100 per instance. Alcohol requires explicit business entertainment justification. Itemized receipts are mandatory for all claims over $25.

Travel & Transport.description: Standard economy class travel, rideshare (Uber/Lyft/taxi), and train fares incurred during official business travel. Receipts are mandatory regardless of amount for air/rail.

Accommodation.description: Standard hotel room rates up to $250/night. Personal mini-bar, in-room movies, or spa charges are strictly non-reimbursable.

Office Supplies & Subscriptions.description: Stationery, small peripherals, and authorized productivity software licenses required for job execution. Hardware over $150 requires pre-approval from IT.
